source.title: Londonderry Sentinel, 10 June 1964, p. 15 ("Ten-vote winning margin")
source.publisher: Londonderry Sentinel (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: The Kilrea count read on the page image of the Londonderry Sentinel, 10 June 1964, p. 15 ('Kilrea—David Lennox 226; John H. Knipe 214'), and the nomination report in the Belfast Telegraph of 20 May 1964 (council-audit, Nov 2026).

note: Triennial election of Coleraine Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. Only Kilrea was contested; Boveedy is the one other division whose new member is named in the reports read. The other eighteen members were returned unopposed but are not individually listed in the sources consulted. Ballylagan and Lislea added from the annual meeting of the new council (meetings gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026).
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of the Londonderry Sentinel, 10 June 1964, p. 15 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the source is the Londonderry Sentinel (it was cited as the Coleraine Chronicle, which the British Newspaper Archive does not hold after 1919; the link was always the Sentinel's); Name_As_Printed 'John H. Knipe' as printed.
